_doc: One config for the control mod: paths, price table, metric targets (from the V4.8/V4.9 rules), hidden-rule catalogue, practices. Edit here; set paths.projects_root to the folder that holds your repos (the <...> paths are placeholders, a missing path is skipped). Thresholds are first guesses from usage-analysis.md (9 Oct); tune them after a week.

prices._doc: USD per million tokens. Input/output from docs/models/models.json (claude.com/pricing, 2 Oct). Cache read = 0.1 x input, cache write = 1.25 x input (5-min cache). Haiku 5.5 has no price in models.json: Haiku 4.5's rate is used (estimate).

hidden_env.CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_MODEL: Every subagent call that names no model runs on this model (V5 §3: Sonnet), whatever the agent type.
hidden_env.CLAUDE_CODE_AUTO_COMPACT_WINDOW: Caps the context window: auto-compaction fires near this size instead of the model's full window.
hidden_env.CLAUDE_CODE_PLUGIN_DIRS: Loads these mod folders into every session (mods can refuse or rewrite tool calls).
hidden_env.ANTHROPIC_MODEL: Overrides the default model of every session.
